description: List content entries (read-only). Each entry carries its publish state under "meta" — status, plus publish_at/expire_at when set — read from the listed locale's meta; singletons and dictionaries carry it at the top level. Local and remote sessions return the same shape. Change status with contentrain_content_status. Returns data from .contentrain/ — do NOT manually create or modify content files.

resolve.description: Resolve relation fields to actual data

name: contentrain_content_list
